reasoning_content: Interesting — no system table in schema? In Drupal 11, module enablement should be stored in the `system` table. Let me check the system module's schema... Actually, Drupal 11.3 should have `system.install` containing schema for the `system` table. Let me verify.

action.command:
cd /workspace
ls web/core/modules/system/ | head; grep -n "schema" web/core/modules/system/system.install | head -5; echo "==="; sed -n '/function schema/,/^}/p' web/core/modules/system/system.install | head -40

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace\nls web/core/modules/system/ | head; grep -n \"schema\" web/core/modules/system/system.install | head -5; echo \"===\"; sed -n '/function schema/,/^}/p' web/core/modules/system/system.install | head -40", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Check system.install schema"}
